author: wighawag
content: Heads-up on EIP-8037 and RPC: in geth master, eth_call / debug_traceCall / eth_simulateV1 (non-strict) get only 2^24 - intrinsic gas of execution gas once Amsterdam is active, even with a 50M gas cap, because the reservoir split in initRuntimeGasBudget ignores SkipTransactionChecks. Views that compute more than ~16.7M gas (on-chain SVG NFTs etc.) work today and fail with a plain "out of gas" after the fork. Repro with `geth --dev --override.amsterdam 0` + curl: https://github.com/ethereum/go-ethereum/issues/35838. Is this intended, and should other clients do the same?

author: mariusvanderwijden
content: This is intended behavior, we limit the amount of regular gas to 1 << 24. Transactions larger than that will also fail today on mainnet, they only work on eth_call not when you actually send the tx
